title: The edit review's answer (S12, qa model): nine scores 1 to 5, whether the branding feels natural, every issue with its tag, a summary

look.description: does it match the look: would it sit on the same account as the reference stills

sound.description: sound fit: does each sound fit its moment, nothing cluttering the voice

requirements.description: the requirements are visible: the problem, the share line, the keyword

energy.description: does every scene keep moving, with inertia, depth and edges: content that plays inside its card, a hero that fills the middle, layers behind it, no stretch that stands still

branding_natural.description: the FlashFX branding (the DM card, the lockup, the brand slot) feels like a natural part of the reel, not like an ad

branding_note.description: when branding_natural is false: what feels like an ad

tag.description: the step that owns the fix: voice (the voiceover), animation (the scenes and components), text (captions and card texts), transition (how scenes leave and arrive), sfx (the sounds)

text.description: one concrete, actionable sentence: what is wrong, where (scene, time) and what would fix it

scene.description: the scene id (s3) when the issue sits in one

summary.description: two or three sentences: what works, what does not, what to change first
